xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF from GitHub issue #2578 — atomic plan.status stamp on completed/ move

plan.title: bug(scope): completed/ xBRIEFs must stamp plan.status completed|failed atomically with the folder move

narratives.Description: During v0.78.0 release, D2 validate failed because six files under xbrief/completed/ retained non-terminal plan.status (proposed/running). Lifecycle folder and JSON status drift blocks release/CI.
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

Files can land in `completed/` while `plan.status` remains `proposed` or `running`. Release Step 5 (`vbrief:validate` D2) then fails late even though work shipped.

## Fix

1. `scope:complete` / `scope:fail` write terminal status directly at the destination path (same write as folder placement)
2. `reconcile:issues` reports and repairs `completed/` + non-terminal status
3. Regression tests + CHANGELOG
narratives.Acceptance:
1. completed/ move stamps plan.status=completed|failed in same write
2. reconcile/report for completed/+non-terminal
3. regression tests + CHANGELOG [Unreleased]

items.title: Atomic status stamp on completed/ move

narrative.Acceptance: Given an active xBRIEF, when scope:complete or scope:fail runs, then plan.status is written at the destination path in the same operation as the folder move (never left non-terminal in completed/).
Given xBRIEFs already in completed/ with non-terminal plan.status, when reconcile:issues runs, then they are reported; with --apply-lifecycle-fixes they are stamped to completed in place.
Transition and reconcile tests cover atomic move and drift repair; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] documents the fix.
